```artifact
Feature: System Back-up and User Authentication
  As a system administrator,
  I want to ensure that the system performs full back-ups every night and rotates them every 30 days,
  So that the data is safe and recoverable.

  Scenario: Full back-up of the system is taken every night
    Given the system is configured to perform nightly back-ups
    When the system performs a back-up at midnight
    Then a full back-up of the database and code is created
    And the back-up is sent to the remote site for safekeeping

  Scenario: Back-ups are rotated every 30 days
    Given the system has performed back-ups for 30 days
    When the system performs a back-up on the 31st day
    Then the oldest back-up is deleted
    And the new back-up is added to the remote site

Feature: User Authentication and Registration
  As a user,
  I want to be able to change my password and log in using my credentials,
  So that I can securely access the system.

  Scenario Outline: Doctors, Chemists, and Labs can change their password
    Given <user_type> is logged into the system
    When <user_type> changes their password to "<new_password>"
    Then <user_type> can log in using the new password "<new_password>"

    Examples:
      | user_type | new_password |
      | Doctor    | NewPass123   |
      | Chemist   | NewPass456   |
      | Lab       | NewPass789   |

  Scenario Outline: Patients can register with a User-id and Password
    Given a patient is on the registration page
    When the patient enters "<user_id>" and "<password>"
    And the patient submits the registration form
    Then the patient can log in using the User-id "<user_id>" and Password "<password>"

    Examples:
      | user_id  | password   |
      | patient1 | PatientPass1 |
      | patient2 | PatientPass2 |
      | patient3 | PatientPass3 |

Feature: Report Generation
  As a system administrator,
  I want the system to generate specific reports,
  So that I can analyze the system's performance and revenue.

  Scenario: Doctor wise Appointment file for next 5 days is generated
    Given the system has appointment data for the next 5 days
    When the system generates the Doctor wise Appointment file
    Then the report contains appointments for each doctor for the next 5 days

  Scenario: Speciality wise - Number of Consultations by Doctor per month/quarter/year is generated
    Given the system has consultation data for the last day of the month
    When the system generates the Speciality wise Consultations report
    Then the report contains the number of consultations by doctor per month/quarter/year

  Scenario: Speciality wise - Revenue Earned per month/quarter/year is generated
    Given the system has revenue data for the last day of the month
    When the system generates the Speciality wise Revenue report
    Then the report contains the revenue earned per month/quarter/year
```
